topic.title: Find Highest Score
topic.description: Finds the highest score in a list of student scores without using the built-in max() function. Builds algorithmic thinking from scratch.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Iterating through a list and updating a tracking variable when a larger value is found.
learningNotes.challenges: Deciding the correct initial value for high_score (first element vs 0).
learningNotes.nextSteps: Also find minimum and average. Then compare with built-in max().

files.description: Finds highest score from list without max().
